name: clip8_countdown_10
objective: Got your Drakefire Amulet yet? Source: Blizzard raid overview.
pages: Dustwallow Marsh. Three phases of heavy fire: build fire resistance and be ready to move.
13 bosses on the summit near Nordrassil, starting with an ancient guardian.
8 bosses in the prison that held Illidan, with entrances in Hyjal, Winterspring and Blackmaw Hold.
All three unlock December 9 and are planned to reset weekly.
Every raider must carry the Drakefire Amulet in their bags. It doesn't need to be equipped.
"Dragonkin Menace" (Burning Steppes), The True Masters, rescue Marshal Windsor from Blackrock Depths, The Great Masquerade, The Dragon's Eye.
"Blood and Thunder" (Kargath), Rend's head, Rexxar in Desolace, Myranda the Hag, Emberstrife and four dragon skulls.
Take the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath in Upper Blackrock Spire.
Blizzard advises starting early, bringing friends for elite quests, and planning several dungeon runs.
Healing potions are made with First Aid in Forever, so anyone can craft a stack.
Onyxia, a full Hyjal clear and a full Barrow Deeps clear are worth 1 point each.
